name: [Negative] App Performance (Slow & Lag)
description: Users consistently report that the application hangs, lags, and runs extremely slowly, leading to frequent freezes and crashes. The sluggishness occurs across multiple devices and usage scenarios, affecting core functionalities such as login, navigation, and data entry.

name: [Negative] App Performance and Stability
description: Users consistently report the application as sluggish, frequently lagging, and sometimes crashing or failing to load. The app’s responsiveness is severely impacted, leading to a poor user experience.

name: [Negative] Severe App Performance & Crash Issues
description: Users report the app constantly crashing, freezing, or taking an excessive amount of time to load screens. The app appears to be unstable, causing the entire device to lag or become unusable.
